title: Concept: Lockfile written in the legacy v1 format
description: package-lock.json declares a lockfile in the legacy v1 format, which records a weaker per-package provenance shape, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: The old format records less provenance per package, so the review sees a weaker graph than a modern lockfile would give it.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through package-lock.json (npm).
risk: The old format records less provenance per package, so the review sees a weaker graph than a modern lockfile would give it.
